_readme: THE NR4A3-FUSION CISTROME SEARCH, 2026-08-08 — the complete, re-runnable corpus. Every value is a JSON/text API endpoint, so scripts/lit_fetch_urls.py writes each payload byte-for-byte; dispatch with .github/workflows/fetch-literature.yml (targets_file=research/manuscripts/fusion-output/lit-targets-nr4a3-cistrome.json). Findings, per-query counts and the retrieval-failure ledger: research/manuscripts/fusion-output/nr4a3-cistrome-search-2026-08-08.md. PURPOSE: settle whether ANY genome-wide chromatin/binding experiment involving an NR4A3 fusion (EWSR1::NR4A3, TAF15::NR4A3, TCF12::NR4A3, TFG::NR4A3, FUS::NR4A3, HSPA8::NR4A3) or NR4A3 in a sarcoma context has been performed or deposited. WHY IT HAD TO BE RE-RUN WIDER: the prior repository search (research/modalities/emc-ret-cistrome.json) was ANTIGEN-CENTRIC — antigen in {NR4A1,NR4A2,NR4A3} and method vocabulary 'chip seq'/'chip-seq'/'chipseq' only — so it could not see a fusion assayed by ATAC/CUT&RUN/CUT&Tag, a fusion ChIP labelled by its 5' partner, or a deposit reachable only through SRA/BioProject/BioSample/ENA. ANSWER: it exists — GSE243553. Keys prefixed 'ctrl_' are KNOWN-POSITIVE CONTROLS: each must return a non-zero count, or that archive's zero is a transport failure rather than an absence.
_disputed_identity_notice: ⛔ DISPUTED-IDENTITY MODEL NAMED IN THIS CORPUS — H-EMC-SS / ACH-001519 / CVCL_1238 (OBJ-LINE-HEMCSS, status identity_disputed). It appears in three query strings only — `gds_14_emc_cell_lines`, `r2_gds_14_emc_cell_lines` and `r2_epmc_emc_cellline_chromatin` — and it is an INTERROGATED SEARCH TERM, never a source of a property: nothing in this corpus or in nr4a3-cistrome-search-2026-08-08.md reads a fusion status, an expression value or a dependency off that model. The curated record holds that the line does NOT carry an EWSR1 fusion (research/manuscripts/surface-targets/emc-surface-target-landscape.md -> Amendment 1), so a chromatin dataset keyed to it would NOT have been evidence about an NR4A3 fusion. The question is moot in fact as well as in principle: measured 2026-08-08, the query returned 53 GEO records of which 3 name the line (GSM1669877, GSM959004, GSM827448) and all 3 are expression samples in multi-line panels, while `gds_04_disease_x_methods` returned 0. Classified `unaffected` in research/manuscripts/emc-systems-map.json -> OBJ-LINE-HEMCSS.read_by; the use is interrogated as a search term only; returned no chromatin dataset. ⚠ The mention is deliberately retained rather than deleted — a search record that hides which models it interrogated cannot be re-run, and 'we looked and found nothing' is a different fact from 'we never looked'.
_rounds: R1 = the 78-target sweep (counts and ID lists). R2A = resolve every ID R1 returned to a title, cell line and library strategy. R2B = re-run every R1 target that failed on HTTP 429/502/400 — an absent reading is not a reading of absence. R3 = resolve the remaining ID lists, chase the two leads R1/R2 surfaced. R4 = test the one paper that could falsify the negative (PMID 39048711). R5 = characterise its deposit. Prefixes r2_/r3_/r4_/r5_ mark the round.
_retrieved_identifiers_2026_08_08: Identifiers READ OUT of the payloads these queries returned on 2026-08-08 (each traceable to the named query and to branch literature-cache, literature/nr4a3-cistrome-search*/): THE HIT — GSE243553 (PMID 39048711, PMC13105821, doi 10.1038/s41587-024-02347-4; preprint doi 10.1101/2023.09.20.555752), 24 samples GSM7790859-GSM7790882, HEK293T pooled scATAC (Spear-ATAC) over >100 oncofusions including EWSR1-NR4A3, TAF15-NR4A3, TCF12-NR4A3 and TFG-NR4A3, with full-length wild-type NR4A3 and the reciprocal NR4A3-EWSR1 as controls. NEW NR4A3 OCCUPANCY SURROGATE — GSE254076 (NR4A3 CUT&Tag, mouse VSMC), sibling GSE254075, SuperSeries GSE254078. SIBLING-FUSION CISTROMES, NOT EMC — GSE235218 (ATAC-seq, myxoid liposarcoma and Ewing sarcoma cell lines, PMID 40988026), GSE163585 and GSE196000 (HEY1-NCOA2 mesenchymal chondrosarcoma ChIP-seq), GSE100936 (Gli1/Gli2 ChIP-seq in chondrosarcoma), GSE270026, GSE144303. EMC EXPRESSION DEPOSITS SEEN BY THE DISEASE QUERIES — GSE4303, GSE24369, GSE28866, GSE11185 (with GDS3481; HEK293 tet-on EWS/NOR1 construct, expression only), GSE80126, GSE43632, GSE299349. CANDIDATE FOURTH EMC COHORT, RNA not chromatin — BioProject PRJNA1357027 / SRA study SRP640302, 12 TempO-Seq runs of EMC. CONTROLS THAT RETURNED — PMID 15920699 (Subramanian, the EMC array cohort behind GSE4303) on both the NCBI and Europe PMC arms. ALSO NAMED — PMID 30664630 (Haller, enhancer hijacking of native NR4A3 in acinic cell carcinoma; processed peaks doi 10.5281/zenodo.1483691) and PMID 35390276 (FUS::DDIT3 chromatin), both already in the manuscript's record.
_failures_are_recorded_not_hidden: ENCODE returned HTTP 502 to all 13 attempts across R1/R2A/R3/R4 including a trivial CTCF control, so ENCODE is NOT RETRIEVED rather than empty; ENCODE experiments are mirrored into GEO and indexed by ChIP-Atlas, both of which were searched. NCBI returned HTTP 429 to 23 R1 targets, every one of which was re-run in R2B/R3 until it answered. Zenodo rejects size>25 unauthenticated (HTTP 400 in R1/R2); re-run at size=25 in R3. chip-atlas cellTypeList.tab is HTTP 404 (antigenList.tab is not). ReMap's api/v1 endpoints time out and CistromeDB's api/inspector answers 'Request denied!'. esearch has no db=gap, so dbGaP is reachable only through BioProject.
